Video name: Who invented the Rubik's Cube in 1974?
column7: Ernő Rubik from Hungary built it to help his students understand how objects move in 3D.

Video name: Roughly how many ways can a 3x3 Rubik's Cube be scrambled?
column7: That's 43,252,003,274,489,856,000 positions, but only one of them is solved!

Video name: What is "God's Number", the most moves ever needed to solve any scramble?
column7: Computers proved it in 2010 after checking every position. It took about 35 years of CPU time.

Video name: How many small cubes can you see on the outside of a 3x3 Rubik's Cube?
column7: 6 centres, 8 corners and 12 edges. There is no cube in the middle, just a spinning core.

Video name: What was the Rubik's Cube first called in Hungary?
column7: It was the "Bűvös kocka" until 1980, when it went worldwide as the Rubik's Cube.
